summary: No new lesson and no retirement: only BTC/USD has a 20-session trade grade and no agent except the News Analyst has enough_data, so L2, L3, L4, L6 and L7 were confirmed from today's run files, and L6 was tightened to 'only clauses the agents' inputs can measure' after INCY's unmeasurable XLV clause and its 'will be restated' stop text. Three owner suggestions were added: check how index-level QQQ/VOO news flags are graded (6 of 8 graded wrong although QQQ fell 2-5% in four of them), add held single-name price series to the packet, and watch items covering cash drag, WMT's close-based stop into its ~11-19 print, and the 20-session grades due about 11-17.
